acceptanceCovered: Two admins demoting each other concurrently: exactly one succeeds, the other gets 409 LAST_ADMIN; at least one admin always remains; no deadlock
Concurrent promotions of the same user are idempotent with one write; role_updated_by records the first writer
Self-demotion returns 403, env admin demotion returns 409 ENV_ADMIN, a non-admin calling the page, action or export gets 403 with no write, an actor demoted mid-flight gets 403
Total Heart and Level equal HeartStatsQuery.rawTotal and HeroTierQuery for every row; spam kudos excluded and Un Spam restores; anonymous kudos counted for the real sender
Search is accent-insensitive on name or email, filters combine with AND, sort and pagination follow the URL, and q longer than 100 chars shows a validation message
User export rows equal the table rows across all pages, more than EXPORT_MAX_ROWS returns 422 with no file, and formula-like values are neutralised

Overview All row equals the sum of unit rows plus the unassigned row for every column; unassigned row appears only when such profiles exist; zero-activity units show 0; date range is half-open in ADMIN_TIMEZONE; empty range means all time; the URL reproduces the numbers; export includes the All row
Both admin screens match the Figma layout on desktop and stay usable at 375 px, with empty, loading and error states
regressionChecked: role-change lock order: SELECT admins ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE first in every change, so concurrent changes queue in one order (no deadlock); READ COMMITTED re-evaluates the WHERE after the wait so a demoted admin drops out of the locked set; target read is a fresh statement after the lock

zero-admin proof: a demotion passes only with locked set >= 2, actor in set (FORBIDDEN otherwise, no write), actor != target (SELF_DEMOTE first), so the actor always remains; the only other role writer (completeLogin) only promotes env admins

check ordering: business guards (NOT_FOUND, no-op, SELF_DEMOTE, ENV_ADMIN, LAST_ADMIN) before the FORBIDDEN actor check is safe: every write path passes the actor check; conditional UPDATE (role <> target) is a second guard

access control: requireAdmin first in users page, overview page and setUserRoleAction (before Zod); requireAdminApi first in both exports, before any param read; actor id comes only from the session, never from the input schema; exports answer private, no-store with code-only errors

input handling: sort and dir, level, role, unit (uuid or none) are Zod whitelists; sort selects a column from a fixed map, never interpolated; q is trimmed, capped at 100 code points, LIKE-escaped (backslash, percent, underscore) and bound as a parameter; unit goes through eq() as a bound uuid

fragment reuse: hearts use heartCountsSubquery (phase 06) joined to kudos.senderId on public kudos with asOf=now = HeartStatsQuery.rawTotal; Level uses HeroTierQuery.distinctSenderCountSubquery + tierCountRange; no copied SQL

planner guard: SET LOCAL enable_nestloop = off runs inside db.transaction around the single read, so it ends with the transaction and cannot leak through the pool (also safe behind a transaction-mode pooler); the rationale and measured 15.7 s to 48 ms are documented and covered by a plan test
CSV: serializeCsv guards = + - @ tab CR, quotes per RFC 4180, BOM; row cap reads EXPORT_MAX_ROWS+1 and refuses with 422 in one read; columns carry no kudo text; filename in ADMIN_TIMEZONE

overview: one grouped subquery per metric (no kudos x boxes cross join), FULL JOIN departments x members with IS NOT DISTINCT FROM so the NULL unit matches; All row summed in TS from the same rows; range is [from 00:00, to+1 day 00:00) via the shared schema, impossible dates rejected by z.iso.date

findings.summary: Overview export imports adminCsvFilename from the admin-users feature (defined at features/admin-users/server/user-export-columns.ts:54); a generic export helper lives in a sibling feature, so removing or reshaping users export breaks overview; move it to shared/admin (csv-filename.ts) and import from both [Resolved in review-fix round: shared/admin/admin-csv-filename.ts (server-only), both routes import it, no remaining reference to the old definition]

A demoted-in-flight actor can still receive ok:true (target already has the role, no write) or ENV_ADMIN / LAST_ADMIN (reveals env-admin status and admin count) before FORBIDDEN; no write is possible and the order is deliberate (spec 3.4 LAST_ADMIN for the race loser), but with a cheap actor-in-set check first for non-demotions the oracle could shrink; consider only if the spec allows

Every table page, count and export aggregates ALL hearts on public kudos, not just the page; 233 ms at 100k kudos / 200k hearts is within the 500 ms budget but grows linearly; revisit with a materialised or incremental total when volume is 10x

enable_nestloop = off applies to the whole statement (departments, mystery awards joins too), and a clamped out-of-range page opens up to 3 transactions; scoped and measured so acceptable; a plan test with a hard 500 ms wall budget may flake on slow CI hardware, so keep it out of the required gate or loosen it
Self-referencing FK role_updated_by has no index, so deleting a profile seq-scans profiles for SET NULL; negligible at ~5k rows, add an index if profile deletes become routine

The file demotes every other admin in the shared DB and restores them in afterAll; a crash mid-run leaves them demoted (env admins re-promote at login); acceptable on the local test DB, never point it at a shared or staging database
